name: Damian Pinas
summary: The 'death touch' middleweight: 25, with a long frame, a 200-cm reach and one-punch power; five straight first-round knockouts, including Cesar Almeida, a kickboxer never stopped before.

how_they_fight.Defense: Raw; hasn't needed defense in short fights.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Never been past the first round in his current run.
how_they_fight.Striking: Not much happens until it does: picks spots, then lands shots that end fights.

patterns: Patient until he finds the shot
Owner's notes, UFC 332: scary power and big hands.
keys_to_beat: Survive early and drag him long
